title: Your new campus friend has a “sure thing”
scenario: A student you met through an international-student group is friendly and helpful. After several weeks they introduce you to a crypto platform that supposedly helped them cover tuition and offer to coach you through it.

answers.A: Check whether the platform is regulated/recognized where you live and whether withdrawals are independently reported.
answers.B: Try a small amount first and continue only if you can withdraw it successfully.
answers.C: Do not invest through a platform introduced by a new relationship; research independently and seek advice from someone you already trust.

explanation: Investment scams often build relationships first and may allow small withdrawals to deepen trust.
proTip: A helpful person can still be leading you into an unhelpful platform.
